# Fresh test: Online Boutique, four fault types (generated by topo/fresh_test.py)

Scorer designs were frozen before this run. Learned baselines come ONLY from the first 60% of the fault-free snapshots before the run (59 snapshots); false alarms are measured on the other 131 fault-free snapshots. 40 episodes: cpu 10, crash 10, delay 10, abort 10.

Ablation: the per-edge scorer runs WITHOUT fan-out weighting (fanout=False, the 0.7.0 behaviour).
